title: Prospective bundle control manifest (control/manifest.json)
description: Engine-only routing and identity for one prospective bundle, written by `miner prospective-export` as <bundle-root>/control/manifest.json. Matches internal/prospectiveexport.ControlManifest and internal/prospectiveexport.ValidateControlManifest exactly. It lives under control/, which the engine never mounts to a reasoner, so it may carry the repository/commit identity that reviewer/metadata.json's allowlist deliberately omits. Integrity is not carried here: control/checksums.sha256 covers every file under reviewer/. See docs/export-contract.md §9-§10 and engine-runner's docs/prospective-bundle-contract.md.

schema_version.description: Fixed contract version identifier; the engine's boundary validator rejects any other value.

case_id.description: Opaque identifier generated by the miner (GenerateCaseID) from a SHA-256 of repository, PR number, and cutoff. Never a caller-supplied, PR-derived string like "case-15624".

repository.description: owner/repo, copied from the selected correlated record's original.repository and cross-checked against the cache bundle's repository identity.

cutoff_timestamp.description: RFC3339Nano UTC benchmark-view cutoff; must match reviewer/metadata.json's cutoff_timestamp.

base_commit.description: Git merge-base of original.base_sha and original.head_sha, resolved locally via `git merge-base` (not merely copied from the cached provider response). This is the pre-image reviewer/diff.patch is taken from.

cutoff_commit.description: PR head SHA, cross-checked against the cache bundle's head SHA before publication. Its tree is what reviewer/repository/ materializes, and it is the post-image reviewer/diff.patch describes.

snapshot_format.description: Shape of reviewer/repository/: a plain directory tree of regular files, not a Git repository and not a patch to be applied.
